description.zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一。
description.en: The custom ID. The ID can contain lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The ID must be 6 to 64 characters in length and unique for each user.

description.zh:
音/视频ID，仅支持传入一个音/视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看音/视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 音视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the audio or video file. Specify only one ID. Obtain the ID in one of the following ways:

- For a video uploaded in the [VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com), log on to the console and choose **Media Library** > **Audio/Video** to view the ID.

- When you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to create an upload URL and credential, the value of the VideoId parameter in the response is the audio or video ID.

- After the audio or video file is uploaded, call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the ID. The value of the VideoId parameter in the response is the audio or video ID.

descriptions.zh: 音视频上传完成后，点播会对上传完成的音视频源文件进行分析，因此媒资信息是异步生成的。可通过设置[音视频分析完成](~~99935~~)的[事件通知](~~55627~~)，当接收到[音视频分析完成](~~99935~~)的事件通知后，再调用本接口获取音视频信息。
descriptions.en: After an audio or video file is uploaded, VOD analyzes the source file and generates the media asset information asynchronously. You can configure [event notifications](~~55627~~) for [video and audio analysis completion](~~99935~~). After you receive an event notification that indicates the analysis is complete, call this operation to retrieve the audio or video information.
